d7095d34a5.q: What does Maintera do and how was it formed from the merger of TCG Services and Commercial Asset Preservation?
d7095d34a5.a: Maintera handles operating and vacant properties, with TCG primarily concentrating on operating commercial properties and CAP concentrating on vacant commercial properties. Commercial Asset Preservation was acquired by Shore Capital in July 2025, and along with TCG Services which was acquired approximately six months before, they comprise the Maintera Facility Services Platform. TCG and CAP combined have the ability to sell to any type of commercial property whether it's restaurant, retail, industrial, warehouse, or hospitality in any state in the United States or Canada.
d7095d34a5.e: The Ride After the Sale: Marc Insul and Pat Bowe on Choosing a Partner

6755a260d0.q: Why did Mark Insull decide to sell Commercial Asset Preservation and partner with Shore Capital instead of growing independently?
6755a260d0.a: Mark Insull knew from early on when creating CAP with his business partner Alan Bunker that they could only grow the company to a certain size given their own investment capital. They reached that growth ceiling a few years before the sale and started looking for partners that could help create hockey stick type growth and open doors they couldn't access as a privately held company. He had already experienced the benefits of partnership through his prior business sale to Chicago Title.
6755a260d0.e: The Ride After the Sale: Marc Insul and Pat Bowe on Choosing a Partner

c14c242a3f.q: What concrete terms did Shore Capital offer that made it stand out from other potential acquirers of Commercial Asset Preservation?
c14c242a3f.a: Shore Capital came to the table with an offer earlier than other companies and made very few modifications to the initial terms. The offer included an opportunity for Mark to stay on board and serve on the board, which most other bidders did not offer. Shore also provided a real firm commitment on how payment would be made rather than an earn-out type scenario that others proposed. These concrete terms and clear motivation convinced Mark that Shore was the right partner.
c14c242a3f.e: The Ride After the Sale: Marc Insul and Pat Bowe on Choosing a Partner

74c6f71a77.q: How does Shore Capital approach post-merger integration differently than typical private equity firms?
74c6f71a77.a: Shore Capital starts by saying they don't have all the answers and seek to understand where potential partners are in their business and where they feel limitations. The approach focuses on culture, people, and process rather than immediately cutting costs. Shore takes a methodical approach to integration—it's not day one where every function races to the finish line, but rather thoughtful and intentional about where to start based on where there is the most room for opportunity while mitigating risks.
74c6f71a77.e: The Ride After the Sale: Marc Insul and Pat Bowe on Choosing a Partner

00628a91d9.q: What advice does Mark Insull give to founders considering whether they are ready to partner with a private equity firm?
00628a91d9.a: Mark Insull advises that founders must get comfortable with the idea of having someone else involved with their business first and foremost. If you're not mentally at that point, then you're not ready. For those who want to see new places and achieve things they haven't been able to accomplish, a transaction with the right partner is the way forward. The decision should be driven by whether you want to continue as a lifestyle business or achieve growth beyond your current capital constraints.

78ece2ae4a.q: What real-world problems do Commercial Asset Preservation and Maintera solve for vacant commercial properties?
78ece2ae4a.a: Vacant properties attract vandals, are subject to copper theft, and decline in value without proper maintenance. Code enforcement will eventually catch up with property owners who leave vacant buildings neglected, and citations prevent properties from returning to the market. By managing vacant properties proactively, Maintera protects property values, prevents code violations, and keeps properties in a state where they can be returned to the market more quickly.
